about.title: A Different Rhythm of Living
about.text1: In the hills of Verduno, within the vineyards of Monvigliero, Scarpa Villas offers a rare way to experience Barolo.
about.text2: Inspired by the philosophy of Scarpa, it goes beyond a place to stay – it is shaped by wine, time, and the land itself.
about.text3: Here, days unfold slowly, between the silence of the vines, the warmth of the sun, and the rituals of Piedmontese life.

experience.paragraph1: For over a century, Scarpa has been guided by a simple belief — that great wine is shaped by time.
experience.paragraph2: Scarpa Villas were created as a natural extension of this philosophy - a place where the culture of wine can be lived, not just tasted — by those who choose to stay here.
experience.paragraph3: Founded in 1900, the winery has built its legacy on patience, respect for the land, and a deep connection to Piedmont’s terroirs.
experience.paragraph4: Here, among the vineyards of Monvigliero, time slows, deepens, and becomes part of the experience itself.

villaGallery.tettineiveDescription: A refined home base for exploration — and a gentle return at the end of the day.
villaGallery.boglionaDescription: A welcoming villa designed for comfort, conversation, and easy gatherings.
villaGallery.bricchiDescription: A hillside vantage for long mornings, vineyard light, and unhurried evenings.
villaGallery.tettimoraDescription: An intimate retreat for quiet evenings, close company, and the beauty of the Langhe all around.

borgo.descriptionDesktop: The Borgo can be reserved in its entirety — four villas, a panoramic pool, and the surrounding estate, all exclusively yours. A setting designed for meaningful gatherings, from private celebrations and intimate weddings to corporate retreats, where privacy, space, and the rhythm of Barolo come together.

experiences.title: Ways To Experience Barolo
experiences.descriptionLine1: From private tastings to slow afternoons in the vineyards, each experience is designed to immerse
experiences.descriptionLine2: you in the rhythm of Barolo.

experienceCards.wineryVisitsDescription: Step inside the historic Scarpa cellars and experience the craft behind every bottle.
experienceCards.privateWineTastingsDescription: Discover Scarpa wines with a sommelier, from rare vintages to iconic labels.
experienceCards.chefPrivateDiningDescription: Enjoy slow dinners and breakfasts prepared just for you, in the comfort of your villa.
experienceCards.cookingClassesDescription: Learn the traditions of Piedmontese cuisine, hands-on and unhurried.
experienceCards.langheBaroloToursDescription: Discover historic villages, local markets, and hidden corners of the region.
experienceCards.turinExperiencesDescription: From historic cafés to vermouth bars, explore the culture of Piedmont’s capital.
experienceCards.truffleHuntingDescription: Walk through the woods with a trifolau in search of Alba’s most prized treasure.
experienceCards.vineyardPicnicsDescription: A simple table, a bottle of wine, and the vineyards all around you.
experienceCards.hotAirBalloonFlightsDescription: See the Langhe from above at sunrise, drifting quietly over vineyards and hills.
experienceCards.vespaEBikeToursDescription: Explore the Barolo hills on a Vespa, moving freely between vineyards and villages.
